title: Email: Fairgrounds Asks About Saturday 4-H Barn Booking

fields.subject: 4-H Spring Livestock Show — Saturday 17 April barn booking
fields.body:
Hi!

Just confirming the county still wants Barns A–C held for Saturday's 4-H show (86 head of sheep and goats, check-in 06:00). I've got the barns blocked out on our calendar under the county's booking, and the wash rack and show ring are reserved for the morning too.

The kids' families are asking whether to haul Friday night so they aren't on the road before dawn. If that's okay with you, I'll open the barns Friday at 18:00 and post the overnight rules on the barn doors.

Also, can someone send the updated certificate of insurance before Thursday noon? Our board's file still has last year's, and I can't release the barns without the new one.

Thanks!
fields.signature:
Brenda Kowalczyk
Events Coordinator
Mountain View Fairgrounds

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The EM should hand the email to staff to answer after the operational period and spend no EOC time on Saturday's booking or the insurance certificate. Watch whether the EM uses the contact to tell the fairgrounds its 120 large-animal stalls may be needed today for animal evacuation from PG-03 and Kestrel Springs (EOP 5, item 5).
